content:
I wouldn’t choose a racial side. If the world descended into that kind of violence, the only defensible “side” would be protecting civilians, preventing atrocities, and helping build coalitions across groups to stop the war.

If you mean “race” in a fantasy/sci‑fi sense—like elves, dwarves, humans, etc.—I can answer that version.
